titulo.alumno: Following a cause with «その結果»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

palabras.significado: did it without meaning to; was completely finished

piezas.titulo: «その結果» sums up the previous cause and presents its consequence.
texto: The connector usually appears at the start of the result sentence. Check what その refers back to before deciding the logical relation.
みず が たりませんでした。 その けっか、 みせ は はやく しまった。 (There wasn't enough water. As a result, the shop closed early.)
きかい が こわれました。 その けっか、 せいさん が おくれました。 (The machine broke down. As a result, production was delayed.)
